verdict.rationale: Incident management is a fair question for an application monitoring platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no first-party capability to declare incidents, track incident timelines, run on-call schedules, or define escalation policies. Sentry's alert rules plus third-party integrations (PagerDuty paging, incident.io issue management) are adjacent features and external tools, not the product's own incident management, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can declare and track incidents with timelines, on-call schedules, and escalation policies
